limitations: No labeled local Philippine dataset supplied.
Original checkpoint training-image provenance is incomplete; public-split results are regression comparisons, not proof of unseen generalization.
Folder-level blocked-drain boxes do not establish precise blockage localization.

source_manifest.task: Visible roadside surface water and blocked surface drains only

sources.annotation: binary masks converted to region boxes
blocked/clear folders; blocked images use full-image boxes

negative_source.attribution: Arya, Maeda, Ghosh, Toshniwal and Sekimoto; RDD2022
negative_source.review: Dry roads visually reviewed for absence of surface water/visible blocked drains. Snow, wet, puddled and ambiguous scenes excluded.

source_manifest.oversampling: Training only: clear drains 15 copies each; reviewed dry roads 4 copies each. No extra independent information implied.

production_replacement: Installed into models/drainage/surfacedrainage/best.pt after calibration and fixed-route verification
